messages:
clara (product): quick sync 1: customers keep asking for a CSV bulk export on org pages and per-invoice PDF for legal. also mobile: group-by-month collapse requested. figma: https://figma.com/file/zzzz123
hugo (design): agree. propose toolbar: 'Export visible (CSV)' for org, keep PDF per-row in overflow. mobile: collapse month groups with a group-level 'Download month (PDF)'. keeps header simple.
tess (frontend): perf notes: bulk CSV = server job + job_id. for mobile groups, virtualize groups not rows. sample poll flow:
POST /billing/export -> {job_id}
poll /jobs/:id
keep poll backoff >1s.
anya (a11y): accessibility: bulk export toast must be ARIA-live polite and include a keyboardable link to job status. group headers should be buttons with aria-expanded. per-row download needs aria-label with date+amount.
ben (eng): backend will add /billing/export (POST) -> job_id, /jobs/:id for status, /invoice/:id/pdf. will include X-RateLimit headers. add job email notify when ready.
rita (data): metrics from pilot: org-level CSV requested in 44% of cases, PDF per-row in 58% of project flows. recommend A/B: variant A toolbar CSV primary, B toolbar PDF primary. metrics: export_clicks, support_starts, export_success_rate.
notify-bot: export_job queued id=job_4523 org=acme-inc month=2026-04
clara (product): consensus=toolbar CSV default for org + per-row PDF in overflow; project pages keep per-row PDFs + inline metadata. action items: (1) hugo post updated frames (2) ben PR for endpoints + email notify (3) tess implement UI + polling + lazy group hydrate (4) anya a11y checklist (5) rita AB dashboard. sync Fri 10am. :white_check_mark:
